name: route119-storm-tail-in-order
checks: C383 storm tail in story order: after Shelly, Route 119 rains even on cycle stage 0 (SUNNY), holds rain over the y=13 cycle line, clears at the Fortree edge SUNNY tiles, Fortree arrival has dolls and 0 boxes, and after the first visit the vanilla cycle returns.

steps.comment: Boots on Route 119 31,14, not the checkpoint's Fortree 0,8: FortreeCity_OnTransition would set FLAG_VISITED_FORTREE_CITY at boot and close the storm tail before the test starts
(b) Route119_OnTransition (TrySetStormTail): rain on the save's cycle stage 0, whose cycle weather is SUNNY (route119-storm-tail-before-shelly)

(c) onto the y=13 cycle line: its weather event sets the stage-0 SUNNY, then the StormTailStep trigger listed after it puts the rain back. FABIAN (32,15) looks along row 15, YASU (28,14) down column 28
(d) north up column 31 and east along row 8 to 34,8, the last rain tile. HIDEO (29,6) looks down column 29: not on this path
(e) the vanilla SUNNY coord event at 35,8 clears the sky at the Fortree edge
(f) the storm still sits over the route: back south onto the y=13 line it rains again, and the edge clears it again
(g) on into Fortree over the connection
(h) expectBoxCount reads the last talk, so press A at the empty row-8 tile: 0 boxes = no arrival script holding a message
(i) the dolls under a clear sky (FLAG_ROUTE104_SKEPTIC_TURNED, the C375 Taken North gate), and the first visit recorded
(j) back onto Route 119: Fortree is visited, so the storm tail is closed and the y=13 line gives the vanilla stage-0 SUNNY
